notes.l05-two-columns-reversed.pdf: known miss: both columns drawn bottom-up, one after the other; no row is split, so nothing shows the order is wrong
notes.l06-two-columns-word-order.pdf: known miss: every word drawn as its own object, last word first; no long piece sits on either side of the gutter
notes.l19-short-columns.pdf: known miss: two rows only, under the three-row threshold
notes.l25-justified-wide-gaps-per-word.pdf: known miss: every word is its own text operation, so the pieces next to the gutter are single words
notes.l02-single-column-shuffled.pdf: out of scope: one column drawn out of order is not a column risk
notes.l14-aligned-table.pdf: known miss: an unruled table drawn column by column; its rows are not recovered and nothing warns about it
notes.l16-label-rows.pdf: known miss on page 1: label pairs drawn column by column read as two lists
notes.q03-unruled-long-cells.pdf: known false positive: an unruled table of long cells, read row by row (correctly), looks like two columns drawn across
notes.q04-label-block.pdf: known false positive: a form-like block of label pairs, read row by row (correctly), looks like two columns drawn across
notes.q02-ruled-table-long-cells.pdf: the same rows inside a ruled grid: the gap holds a vertical line, so it is a cell border, not a gutter, and there is no column warning

q01-no-unicode-only.pdf.note: The PDF's characters have no Unicode mapping, so it has no reliable text.
